label: Roots in the integrand
subgoals: A single square root can be removed by substitution.
Set the root equal to a new variable and solve for x.

label: The rationalizing substitution
subgoals: Higher roots require the corresponding power substitution.
The integrand becomes rational in the new variable.

label: Back-substituting
subgoals: Express the antiderivative in the new variable first.
Replace the new variable with the original root.
